detail.longDescription: I got a # Gnome extension that hides the top bar until/unless I reveal the dashboard, and I *love* it. When I'm looking at an app, that's the only thing I'm looking at. There are a couple of little things I'd rather were more available, but it's worth the trade. My desktop is ~calming~. # Linux # Gnome # FOSS # FLOSS # OpenSource # Computers # tech # technology
